scripts.corpus:check: bun run --cwd packages/analyzer build && bun scripts/generate-entailment-corpus.ts --check
scripts.corpus:update: bun run --cwd packages/analyzer build && bun scripts/generate-entailment-corpus.ts
scripts.gate: bun run typecheck && bun run corpus:check && bun run test:native && bun run lint && bun run fmt && bun run test:fast
